item.tib: o rgyan 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pa'i skyes phreng gsol 'debs skal ldan lam zin
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsal lam 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pa'i skyes 'phreng gsol 'debs skal ldan lam zin zhes bya ba rang mthun grogs bzang res 'gas sngar nas bskul ba dang / khyad par kun grags mchog sprul rin po che yi bka' nan spyi bor phab pa la/ mi ldog tu mkha' 'gro'i lung cha shas la brten nas/ rang 'dod tshul chos kyis dben pa 'bol gtam kha shar du/ yig ris thog mar kun grags pas bgyis tshe/ dge des 'gro kun srid mtshor dbugs 'byin shog/
